title: Speaking — Spending evenings
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on spending evenings.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
How do you normally spend your evenings?
Do you work better late in the day?

part2.topic: Describe an evening when you made good use of a short amount of time.
points: what you needed or wanted to do
part2.closing: and explain why this evening felt productive.

questions: Why do different businesses need to open at different hours?
How can cities support a varied evening economy without disrupting residents?
How has everyday life connected with spending evenings changed for people of different ages?
